source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic 3D-rendered scene of a futuristic scientific study room at night, viewed straight-on across a wide brushed-metal desk. On the left, a large floating transparent holographic display with a glowing cyan border and dark teal background, titled “EvidenceGrade AI” in bold white sans-serif lettering, with the subtitle “5-tier grade”; five horizontal colored grade bars labeled “A”, “B”, “C”, “D”, and “F” in emerald green, turquoise, yellow, orange, and crimson, beside a rising cyan line graph titled “Citation Confidence 2019-2026”, with a vertical scale from 0 to 60 and the repeated caption “Citation Confidence 2019-2026” beneath it. In the center, a luminous translucent turquoise glass DNA double helix floats vertically above the desk, constructed from glossy tubular strands, spherical joints, and small gold metallic connectors, softly illuminated and reflected on the tabletop. In the foreground left, an open spiral-bound notebook rests on a brown leather desk pad, filled with small handwritten notes and diagrams, with the legible heading “CYP3A4 interaction risk” on the right page and a dark green fountain pen lying diagonally across it. In the foreground right, a white ceramic coffee cup with subtle gray marble veining, a teal silicone lid, and a matching handle sits on a white saucer with fine gold crackle lines. The background contains a dark teal laboratory wall with two white floating shelves holding amber apothecary bottles labeled “Aspirin”, “Warfarin”, and “Ibuprofen”, additional medicine bottles, binders, and small glass containers; a vintage brass microscope stands on the rear counter. A lush monstera plant in a white pot sits to the right of the DNA model. Overhead, several antique brass articulated lamps and pendant lights hang at different heights, including a large cream-colored dome shade and a green glass shade, casting warm pools of light through a slightly hazy atmosphere. On the right, a tall arched industrial window with thick dark frames reveals a rainy neon-lit city street, glowing pink, red, and cyan vertical signs with blurred East Asian characters, wet reflections, and cool blue evening light; a black cat sits in silhouette on the windowsill beside a closed deep-red umbrella with a curved wooden handle. Moody teal-and-amber color grading, volumetric light, soft shadows, realistic glass and metal reflections, shallow atmospheric depth, highly detailed materials, cinematic composition, ultra-detailed concept art, 16:9 aspect ratio.
